title: The Weather Goat's Window
summary: Pemmy the weather goat stamped CLEAR on the brass chart at dawn, which buys exactly one goat-certified window of calm to re-wax the storm gauge's sensors on the far ridge. Three minutes, goat time. The Guild would like its forecast back.

objectives.label: Collect the sensor wax from the weather desk loft
Return the stamped slip before the window closes

offer.text: The weather desk picked a fight with the season again. Pemmy stood on CLEAR this morning and stamped it four times, which the guild reads as a window of exactly three minutes — goat minutes, which run generous but not generous.
Storm gauge on the far ridge needs its sensors re-waxed or the whole desk flies blind, and if the desk flies blind, Pemmy retires to a stew pot. Nobody wants that. The goat has seniority.

accept.text: Wax is in the loft by the water tower, next to the brass chart — do not touch the chart, the goat has a union. There and back inside the window. Pemmy has eaten three stopwatches; she knows what three minutes feels like.
Racing a goat's timetable. My career continues its long, dignified arc.

complete.text: Back inside the window with the slip stamped. The gauge is singing again and the desk forecasts: dust, wind, and a courier who cuts it fine. Two out of three were already on the chart.
Ketch here. Tamsin says you outran a goat. Day one at the garage I told you this job had variety.
